याच् (akin to या), i. 1, Par. Ātm.
 1. To ask, Vikr. d. 41; to solicit, Daśak. in
. With the acc. of the object and of the person,
; also with the abl. of the person,

. To offer, to tender.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. याचित.
 1. Importuned, Yājñ. 2, 238.
 2. Requisite, necessary, Pañc. 182, 13.
 --Comp.
 --Caus. याचय, To cause to be asked, Pañc. 25, 15; to be invited,

.
 --With the prep. अभि अभि, To ask, to beg; with two acc.,
. Offered to the deities to render them propitious. n. A vow, Pañc. ii. d. 50; a demand,

.
 --With प्र प्र,
 1. To beg, to solicit,

.
 --With संप्र सम्-प्र, The same, 3, 8696.
 --With सम् सम्, The same, 3, 8837.
 --Cf. αἰτέω, and perhaps ζητέω.
याच् + अक, adj. Asking, a beggar, Pañc. ii. d. 110.
याच् + अन + क, adj. Begging importunately,
याच् + अना, Caus., f. Asking, [] soliciting,
, where the Sch. takes it as n.).
याचित + क (vb. याच्), n. A borrowed thing.
याच् + इष्णु + ता, f. Habit of soliciting favours,
याच्ञा, i. e. याच् + न, f. Begging, Hit. i. d. 97, M.M.
